retrieval_metrics.precision_at_k: Fraction of top-k retrieved slots labelled relevant (binary labels via hidden theme tags).
retrieval_metrics.recall_at_k: Fraction of all gold-relevant memories that appear in top-k.
retrieval_metrics.hit_at_k: 1 if at least one relevant memory appears in top-k (0 if none).
retrieval_metrics.reciprocal_rank: 1/rank of first relevant retrieved item; 0 if none.
retrieval_metrics.ndcg_at_k: Normalized DCG with binary gains; ideal = all relevant items at top (Jarvelin & Kekalainen, 2002).

limitations: Stub hash embeddings differ from production sentence embeddings — run periodic smoke tests against real Qdrant + embedder.
Binary relevance tags are coarse; LLM judge adds a second signal but is not ground truth.
off_topic_same_user penalises any retrieval — embedding models often still return near-neighbours; read false_positive_retrieval.
evaluation_design.judge_usage: Set MEMORY_BENCH_USE_JUDGE=true; GROQ_API_KEY is read from the environment. The retrieval judge module loads chatbotAgent/.env then repo-root .env (override=false), same pattern as tests/llm_judge.py.

notes: IR metrics are gold-label based; they do not depend on LLM self-evaluation.
Groq judge is a secondary signal — compare against hit_at_k when numbers disagree.
